summary: Iteration 1 — full backend + frontend smoke for 3Tattava revamp. 18/18 backend API tests pass (pytest). All critical frontend flows pass end-to-end: home renders with all 14 sections + hero/header, every nav link routes correctly, shop lists 4 seeded products, product detail loads with Add-to-Cart, CartDrawer opens and Checkout CTA navigates to /checkout/cart, full Cart→Address→Payment→Place Order flow completes and redirects to /order-confirmation/:id, newsletter submission shows 'Welcome to the Circle.' confirmation, Performance Assessment submits and renders Score 60/100 + Momentum stage + RockResin recommendation, Dosha Quiz page renders, VaidyaConnect shows 2 doctor cards, FindUs renders all 29 WTF locations, Admin login with token '3tattava-admin-2026' authenticates and dashboard shows logout, 404 page shows 'Lost In The Himalayas' design. No console errors captured during runs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 667 lines and still readable; if more endpoints are added split into routers/ (products, orders, admin, leads).
All endpoints correctly exclude MongoDB _id via projection {_id: 0} or clean() helper — good.
Admin auth correctly differentiates 401 (missing) vs 403 (invalid) tokens.

Order total currently does NOT add shipping (free above ₹999 else ₹49). server.py /api/orders only sums items*qty. The problem statement mentions free-shipping rule (₹49 below ₹999) — frontend may compute it for display, but persisted order.total ignores it. Consider folding shipping into the persisted total or returning subtotal + shipping + total explicitly.

Newsletter / leads / contacts / assessments / dosha_quizzes have no admin GET endpoints for assessments, dosha_quizzes, contacts (only orders/leads/newsletter/bookings exist). Add /api/admin/assessments, /api/admin/contacts if admin needs full visibility per problem statement counts.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject that combo for credentialed requests; harmless here (no cookies) but worth tightening for prod.
No rate limiting on public POST endpoints (newsletter/leads/contact/assessment/orders) — spam risk in prod.
seed_data_creation: Backend seed-on-startup verified: 4 products, 2 doctors, 6 knowledge articles, 29 WTF locations. Test data created (TEST_-prefixed) for orders, newsletter (random emails), assessment, dosha quiz, doctor booking — left in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_3tattava_api.py — 18 tests, all green. Re-run: `pytest backend/tests/test_3tattava_api.py -v`. Frontend testids confirmed working: site-header, nav-shop, nav-knowledge-center, nav-vaidyaconnect, nav-research-testing, nav-community, nav-find-us, nav-our-story; home sections trust-strip..final-cta; product-card-*, add-to-cart, cart-drawer, cart-checkout-cta; co-name/email/phone/address/city/state/pincode/to-address/to-payment/place-order; assess-name/email/submit (4 assess-q-* questions); doctor-card-*; location-*; admin-token-input/login-submit/logout. Shipping rule (₹49 below ₹999, free above) not yet enforced server-side — flagged in code-review for main agent.
